name: color-picker
title: Color Picker
author: @fma-ui/ui
description: A composable color picker. ColorPicker holds the color and shares it with parts laid out in any way: ColorPickerTrigger and ColorPickerContent (a popover), ColorPickerPanel (a column of controls, or a standalone inline picker), ColorPickerArea (OKLCH chroma × lightness at the hue, the part sRGB can't show left blank; or HSB saturation × brightness), ColorPickerWheel (a hue ring whose children fill the square inside it), ColorPickerSlider (any channel of OKLCH, HSL, HSB or RGB, or alpha; horizontal or vertical, painted with the colors it reaches), ColorPickerFields (a format menu with hex or per-channel fields) and ColorPickerChannelInput, ColorPickerInput (a text field taking any CSS color, Escape reverting, with a swatch that opens the popover against it), ColorPickerSwatches (presets, Tailwind's palette by default), ColorPickerSwatch, ColorPickerValue, ColorPickerCopy, ColorPickerEyeDropper, ColorPickerPreview and ColorPickerFixContrast; useColorPicker reads and sets the color from custom parts. onChange fires while dragging and onChangeEnd once an interaction ends; format sets what they emit (oklch by default, hex, rgb or hsl) and alpha adds opacity controls. Given a background (contrastWith), every part shows contrast: the area hatches what fails AA and draws the AA and AAA thresholds across it, tracks hatch and mark them, presets failing AA are hatched, the preview shows the WCAG ratio and "Fix to AA/AAA" jumps to the nearest passing lightness keeping the hue. Without children, ColorPicker is a swatch that opens the default panel in a popover. labels translates every text it shows or announces; name submits the value with a form (a hidden input) and a form reset restores the starting color.
